fields.access: r0 on entry to ARM9 helper 0x02065BF4
fields.evidence: The helper bounds-checks the global card ID against the exclusive upper bound 213 before indexing the six-byte Gate table.
fields.initialization: Loaded from the selected global card source immediately before the Gate lookup call.
fields.name: gate_card_id
fields.reset: Ephemeral register argument expires when 0x02065BF4 returns.

fields.access: r1 on entry to ARM9 helper 0x02065BF4
fields.evidence: The helper adds attribute_id to card_id * 6 before loading the unsigned Gate byte.
fields.initialization: Loaded from the active combatant attribute immediately before the Gate lookup call.
fields.name: attribute_id
fields.reset: Ephemeral register argument expires when 0x02065BF4 returns.

fields.access: opponent r2 after 0x0223D0FC; player r1 after 0x0223D118, before the mutable-modifier addition
fields.evidence: The merged overlay-7 patch loads source core G, leaves values at or below 400 unchanged, and replaces higher values with 200 + floor(core / 2) before adding source +0x06. Controlled execution confirmed 650 becomes 525 for both combatants.
fields.initialization: Calculated by the bounded core-G constructor from source-record +0x04.
fields.name: compressed_core_g
fields.reset: Temporary register value is overwritten before constructor return; a System 2.0 hook must capture it at the documented instruction boundary.

fields.access: source participant record +0x06; loaded at 0x0223D0F4 for opponent and 0x0223D110 for player
fields.evidence: Function 0x0226A380 applies signed deltas to the stored nonnegative modifier and clamps core plus modifier to 990. The constructor adds it only after core compression.
fields.initialization: Participant source-record initialization sets or carries the mutable G modifier before battle construction.
fields.name: mutable_modifier_g
fields.reset: The battle source record is replaced or cleared with participant battle state.

fields.evidence: Constructor 0x0223CFE8 stores compressed core plus mutable modifier as the base snapshot used by the later Gate add.
fields.initialization: Stored by the battle constructor after core compression and mutable-modifier addition.
fields.name: base_snapshot_g
fields.reset: Combatant record is discarded with the battle object after completion.

fields.evidence: The constructor zero-initializes this field and later stores Gate table byte * 10 at 0x0223D274. Runtime captures observed 180 and 100.
fields.initialization: Zeroed during battle construction and replaced by the active Gate attribute bonus.
fields.name: gate_bonus_g
fields.reset: Combatant record is discarded with the battle object after completion.

fields.evidence: 0x0223D288 adds base snapshot and Gate bonus; 0x0223D28C stores the target total. Runtime equations were 230 + 180 = 410 and 190 + 100 = 290.
fields.initialization: Stored after the Gate calculation at 0x0223D28C.
fields.name: target_total_g
fields.reset: Combatant record is discarded with the battle object after completion.

fields.evidence: Function 0x0223DDAC moves this value toward target_total_g by 3 G per frame and is presentation-only.
fields.exclusion_reason: Presentation tween state is not a stable gameplay input for Gate effects.
fields.initialization: Initialized from the base snapshot before the Gate display tween.
fields.name: animated_current_g
fields.reset: Combatant record is discarded with the battle object after completion.

fields.access: r5 at 0x0223D288 for the record whose target total is being calculated
fields.evidence: Target-total watchpoint captures identify r5 as the current 20-byte combatant record base for both opponent and player stores.
fields.initialization: Derived from the battle object's combatant record array before Gate-total calculation.
fields.name: combatant_record_pointer
fields.reset: Ephemeral pointer register is no longer valid after the owning battle object is destroyed.

fields.evidence: The constructor stores either metadata field 2 or an explicit type at +0x20, and the six-way dispatcher consumes values 0-5.
fields.initialization: Stored at 0x0223E344 or 0x0223E354 during battle-object construction.
fields.name: battle_type_id
fields.reset: Battle object is marked complete in state 8 and later discarded.

fields.evidence: Dispatcher 0x0223EA60 switches over state values 0-8 and advances the byte as each battle phase completes.
fields.initialization: Battle-object constructor initializes the state machine before first dispatch.
fields.name: battle_state
fields.reset: State 8 propagates completion and marks the object done before destruction.

fields.evidence: Codes 1-6 overwrite battle object +0x20 with fixed battle types; codes 0 and 7 preserve the selected type.
fields.exclusion_reason: The upstream initialization and semantic owner of this scripted override byte are not yet mapped.
fields.name: battle_type_override_code
fields.owner_structure: battle data referenced by overlay-7 battle object
fields.reset: Discarded with the owning battle data.

fields.evidence: The Gate-card-get cut-in constructor stores an actor slot byte at +0x18, but it has not been proven to be the canonical Gate owner.

fields.reset: Cut-in state 3 marks the object done and releases its scene.
